# Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/enterprise-patterns/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 32 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$enterprise-patterns:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 21 roles in `../agents/enterprise-patterns-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs enterprise-patterns`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/enterprise-patterns/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
